messages:
sara_pm: Thanks team — quick follow-up from the postmortem I just posted: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/1799120000-model-fallback-loop. I pulled the action items into one list, need owners, JIRA IDs, and RACI for each. Can folks claim items and set due dates?

sara_pm: Action items (short):
1) Fix fallback loop root cause (ensure backoff + dedupe) — prev: transient model selector bug
2) Add automated canary for model rollout that simulates KV cache warmup
3) Alerting: create latency spike playbook + runbook hookup to oncall
4) Cost regression guardrail for model fallbacks (billing telemetry + quota throttle)
5) Post-deploy e2e test in CI that runs a short perf profile

sara_pm: For each, please reply with: `owner / JIRA / RACI (R/A/C/I) / due (ISO date)`

amelia_eng: I'll take 1. owner: amelia_eng / JIRA: RI-2418 / RACI: R=amelia_eng A=sara_pm C=liz_runtime,marcus_sre I=eng-all / due: 2026-04-08

raj_infra: I'll own 2. owner: raj_infra / JIRA: RI-2419 / RACI: R=raj_infra A=ops-eng C=amelia_eng,liz_runtime I=platform-team / due: 2026-04-15

marcus_sre: I'll pick up 3. owner: marcus_sre / JIRA: RI-2420 / RACI: R=marcus_sre A=eng-sre C=oncall,raj_infra I=eng-all / due: 2026-04-01

liz_runtime: I'll take 4 and 5 but will split the tasks:
- 4a) billing telemetry integration owner: liz_runtime / JIRA: RI-2421 / RACI: R=liz_runtime A=finance C=marcus_sre I=product / due: 2026-04-12
- 4b) quota throttle prototype owner: liz_runtime + raj_infra / JIRA: RI-2422 / RACI: R=liz_runtime,raj_infra A=ops-eng C=finance I=eng-all / due: 2026-04-22
- 5) post-deploy e2e owner: liz_runtime / JIRA: RI-2423 / RACI: R=liz_runtime A=ci-team C=amelia_eng I=eng-oncall / due: 2026-04-10

marcus_sre: quick note on 3 — I'll add a playbook draft to RI-2420 and link the runbook to the incident channel. Suggest we add a runbook step to temporarily pin model variants to avoid fallback loops during mitigation.

amelia_eng: For 1, I'm going to add a small test harness to reproduce the selector race — linking my branch to RI-2418. Also proposing we add an automated regression check in the model onboarding flow so this doesn't regress.

raj_infra: For 2, plan: create a canary deployment pipeline that warms KV cache by replaying representative requests. Will need ~2 GPU-hours per canary; ops budget ok? @sara_pm can you confirm we have budget for weekly canaries?

sara_pm: Budget OK for biweekly canaries for the pilot. Let's start with weekly for first 2 runs then adjust. Confirmed.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Postmortem action items weekly sync" — first recurring check-in created for 2026-03-30 15:00 UTC. Assigned: amelia_eng, raj_infra, marcus_sre, liz_runtime.

marcus_sre: Also noticed a pattern across the last 3 incidents — model selector races on cold-start + simultaneous rollouts. Propose a small investigation ticket to map frequency and root contributors. owner: marcus_sre / JIRA: RI-2424 / due: 2026-04-05 / RACI: R=marcus_sre A=eng-sre C=eng-runtime I=product

amelia_eng: Agree — if we find it's a recurring pattern we should add a 'safe-rollout' gating rule in the deployment orchestration. I'll collaborate with raj on gating criteria.

sara_pm: Great. To recap owners and primaries: 1=amelia_eng (RI-2418), 2=raj_infra (RI-2419), 3=marcus_sre (RI-2420), 4a/b/5=liz_runtime (RI-2421/RI-2422/RI-2423), investigation=marcus_sre (RI-2424).

sara_pm: Next steps: everyone make sure their JIRA tickets have acceptance criteria and a short test plan. ops-bot will ping owners 48h before due date. We'll review progress in the weekly sync on 2026-03-30. If anyone needs to hand off an item, post here and tag the new owner.

raj_infra: tagging handoff plan now — if I need to hand off 2 to platform team, I'll add a checklist under RI-2419 and set the assignee to platform_lead.

liz_runtime: noted. I'll add CI checks for 5 and a lightweight perf smoke in the PR.

sara_pm: Thanks all — closing this thread for now, will re-open if owners update status. :thumbsup:
